summary: The Wagner Manufacturing Company was a family-owned maker of cast iron and aluminum products in Sidney, Ohio. It produced household cookware such as frying pans, casseroles, kettles and baking trays, as well as other metal products. Active from 1891 to 1952, it once dominated the cookware market in Europe and the US. After its 1952 sale the brand continued, and original pieces are prized by collectors.
one_line: Wagner Manufacturing Company was a Sidney, Ohio cast iron and aluminum cookware maker active from 1891 to 1952.
key_facts: The Wagner Manufacturing Company was a family-owned manufacturer of cast iron and aluminum products.
The Wagner Manufacturing Company was based in Sidney, Ohio, US.
The company made domestic products such as frying pans, casseroles, kettles and baking trays.
The company also made metal products other than cookware.
The Wagner Manufacturing Company was active between 1891 and 1952.
At one time the Wagner Manufacturing Company dominated the cookware market.
The Wagner Manufacturing Company sold its cookware in Europe and the US.
The purchasers of the Wagner Manufacturing Company in 1952 continued the brand.
Wagner products are still manufactured today.
The original Wagner Manufacturing Company items are prized by collectors.
